Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted “older director” by comparing the directors’ ages at the time of their films’ releases (37 vs 31) instead of overall age based on birth years, then gave a contradictory conclusion, claiming Don McGuire (born 1919) was older than Nunzio Malasomma (born 1894) by 6 years. This flawed comparison and misapplication of the birth years led to the wrong answer.
